Game Overview

Best Friend DIY is a puzzle title where join Galya, a scientist in need of companionship, on her quest to use logic and creativity in crafting the perfect friend in her lab. Navigate through this charming puzzle game where each ingredient choice leads to delightful discoveries or unexpected monstrous mishaps. Unleash science-powered fun and friendship!
